ci-bot: Pipeline failed on release/v1.9.0 -> job=integration-db-migrations (parallel-3)
ci-bot: Failed test: UserSessionExpiryTest::test_session_expires_after_ttl
ci-bot: Error: timeout waiting for container healthcheck (container user-session-db-7)
ci-bot: Logs: ```
2026-03-18 14:10:02 [ERROR] SessionCleaner - expected 1 expired sessions, found 0
org.junit.ComparisonFailure: expected:<1> but was:<0>
    at ...UserSessionExpiryTest.test_session_expires(UserSessionExpiryTest.java:47)
    at ...
Caused by: TimeoutException: Waited 30s for healthcheck
```
maria: ugh, that one flaked yesterday too in canary :grimacing:
aj: is it the same root cause as the smoke instability we saw? or a race in the clean-up job?
ken: looks like the healthcheck timeout — maybe DB container startup jitter under load. tests assume deterministic schedule.
sre_lead: we're currently blocked on the v1.9.0 release. change window ends 22:00 UTC.
maria: can we pin the base image to the last green build (sha: a1b2c3d) and re-run CI? faster than debugging right now.
aj: pinning might work, but if tests still flake we'll waste cycles. we could also skip the failing test for gating and open a follow-up.
ken: +1 to pin then run. if green, proceed with release and create ticket to fix test race.
sre_lead: agree — pin base image for release, create issue with priority P0 for root cause and revert test skip once fixed. record in release notes.
maria: i'll cut a branch release/v1.9.0-pinbase and open PR with image pin and CI skip for UserSessionExpiryTest with comment linking the issue.
ci-bot: deploy-bot: re-triggered pipeline for branch release/v1.9.0-pinbase by maria
ci-bot: job queued: integration-db-migrations (parallel-3)
devops-bot: FYI release manager meeting in 15m to confirm rollback policies :calendar: 
aj: posting temporary workaround steps in the PR
maria: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/inference/pull/4521 — includes image pin + test.skip with TODO
ken: once CI passes, we merge and schedule release; if it fails again we'll rollback the cut and open a revert PR.
sre_lead: add note to release channel and update runbook for flaky-test mitigation :white_check_mark:
aj: tagging @maria for follow-through — thanks
maria: on it, will update status here when CI finishes :hourglass:
